Subject: Spike in May usage / ask for credit + VAT handling

Hi Hannah,

We just closed our month and saw an unexpected amplification in token usage from an integration test that flew under our radar. Our finance team is asking if Redwood can issue a credit for the incremental May spend and -- importantly for us -- provide EU VAT documentation so we can reclaim VAT correctly.

Attached is a short CSV with the usage lines we think are problematic. Can you help route this to billing and tax so we can reconcile before our month-end close?

Thanks,
Elena
--

Head of Finance, CloudFleet
elena@cloudfleet.com

Elena —

Thanks for sending this over and sorry for the disruption. I pulled the CSV and flagged the May-14 integration run that appears to have been a backfill. Ben / Laura: tagging you to coordinate the credit and VAT evidence.

Proposed next steps:
- Ben to validate usage delta and propose a goodwill credit (service credit) for the excess tokens.
- Laura to pull the EU VAT proof and provide the invoice-level VAT support CloudFleet needs.
- Hannah to confirm credit routing (apply to next invoice vs. one-time credit memo) and inform CloudFleet of timelines.

Elena — I can confirm we will keep collections on hold while we resolve (no dunning or collections until we close this out). Expect a formal proposal from us within 48 hours.

Best,

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Calculation: recommended goodwill credit for CloudFleet (May spike)

Team / Elena,

I reviewed the usage file and matched line items against our ingestion logs. Summary:
- Baseline expected May spend (projected usage profile): $28,450
- Actual billed May spend: $42,710
- Spike attributable to integration backfill (approx): $13,820

Recommendation: issue a goodwill credit equal to the spike ($13,820) as a one-line credit memo. Rationale: single misconfigured backfill, first occurrence, strong partnership.

Options for application:
1) One-time credit memo (reduces outstanding balance and appears on next statement).
2) Apply as a negative adjustment to the upcoming invoice (same net effect).

I lean to option 1 to keep the accounting clean. Also, I can prepare a proposed credit note PDF for Elena to sign if required.

Attachment: proposed_goodwill_credit_note.pdf (preview).

Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@cloudfleet.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: VAT evidence and suggested routing for EU reclaim

Hi Elena,

I pulled the VAT certificate and invoice detail. CloudFleet is VAT-registered in Ireland per the VAT certificate you provided. For EU reclaim we can provide:
- Invoice-level VAT lines (we can regenerate an invoice with explicit VAT breakdown)
- A signed credit note showing the negative adjustment with VAT handling mirrored on the note

If you need a VAT-exclusive credit memo (i.e., show the zero-rated movement on your end), we recommend: issue the credit memo gross (including VAT) and include a VAT breakdown PDF. That gives your accounting team what they need to reclaim.

Laura
Revenue Tax & Compliance | Redwood Inference
Attachment: vat_certificate_cloudfleet.pdf
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@cloudfleet.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:21:00 +0100
Subject: Re: VAT evidence and suggested routing for EU reclaim

Thanks Laura / Ben — this looks good. We prefer a one-time credit memo that includes VAT lines so our AP can automatically offset it against the outstanding balance. We can sign the credit note if Redwood requires it.

One ask: can the credit be applied before the next statement generation (we close books on the 27th)? If not, we need a short written confirmation (email) stating Redwood will not pursue collections while this is being processed.

Elena
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: CloudFleet credit routing + VAT handoff — confirmation and next steps

Elena —

Confirming the agreed approach: we will issue a one-time credit memo for $13,820 inclusive of VAT. Laura will attach an invoice-style VAT breakdown and provide a signed credit note PDF. We will apply the credit before your next statement cycle; collections on the outstanding balance will be paused until the credit is posted.

Ben: please create the credit memo in billing and share the DocuSign link to CloudFleet. Aditya: FYI — please hold collections flags for CF-2025-09-178 until June 30.

I'll follow up once the DocuSign is live.

Best,
Hannah
